title: Shift by Shift
description: Return from mining or exploration expeditions. Previews, active crews and survey work do not count.

title: Below the Frontier
description: Complete mining or exploration at these depths. Access upgrades and unworked ground do not count.

title: Made from the Mine
description: Fully collect processed material units from paid production. Staged outputs, partial orders and equipment are excluded.

title: Better Ways to Work
description: Complete permanent Deep Claim research nodes. Starting or paying for research alone does not count.

title: A Company of Its Word
description: Fulfill distinct permanent delivery contracts with collected goods. Each order counts once.

title: Built Underground
description: Finish installing functional supports, ventilation, pumps or rail. Construction still in progress does not count.

title: Built Together
description: Help complete different club projects with at least 5% of each project's frozen goal value. Claims and contribution clicks do not add progress.
